title: Michele C NDE 9505
content: I experienced my soul leaving my body. I was in an absolute state of serenity, never before felt on earth. I distinctly saw my body and all my loved ones, or rather the ones who were part of my nuclear family. I had the gift of being everywhere at once. I saw my mother, my grandmother and my sister, all in despair. I would have liked to tell them to not worry since I was feeling wonderful. At the same time, I saw my father at work. He was being advised by someone running beside the ambulance. I saw my father who ran and left his briefcase on the stairs as he rushed into the medical unit. I saw the doctor who shot me with a needle in my veins. As soon as the medicine went into my system, I reentered my body and later woke up in the hospital after several hours. After coming to consciousness, I recounted everything and when I described the specifics including how the medical office looked, which I had not ever seen before, and the fact that I saw my father leave his briefcase on the stairs, my parents were astounded. Since then I understand that death is a rebirth in a different dimension. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1973 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw my father who was at work. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was aware of everything and could see all at once, even my father. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Yes, I was conscious and alert Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time did not exist Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Totally different. I felt an absolute well-being and didn't need anything. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard everything clearly. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Absolute peace Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience No I did not know what could happen after our earthly life. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I live more peacefully Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes It was an experience. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I am conscious that something exists that is different from our earthly life. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I feel more peace when it comes to death, or better said, the life that comes after our earthly life. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes They have deepened After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. A unique experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I am often able to know events that are about to happen in my life. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I look at life with more peace Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I speak often about it with people I meet Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Peacefully What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. In a meaningful way At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Reentered the body as soon as medicine went into the system (injection/IV).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported being 'everywhere at once' and observing family members and father at work; return coincided with injection/medicine entering veins.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with simultaneous remote perceptions; no tunnel/boundary/life review; return triggered by medical injection.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneously perceived own body/family and father at work ('everywhere at once').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived being 'everywhere at once' with apparently verified details (father leaving briefcase on stairs; medical office appearance). Return occurred immediately when medicine entered veins.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I experienced my soul leaving my body.” “I had the gift of being everywhere at once.” “As soon as the medicine went into my system, I reentered my body.”
